digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime and provider abstraction layer
propositions: rebar's LLM runtime currently branches on anthropic provider string matching and refuses base_url/api_key configuration, creating an incomplete abstraction
AWS Bedrock is unsupported; routing through an OpenAI-compatible gateway gateway silently loses prompt caching, retrying, timeouts, and native structured output
pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook and ModelProfile capability profiles enable first-class Bedrock support without provider-name string matching throughout the codebase
signed verdict sidecars must record provider, model, endpoint host, and support tier so consumers can distinguish first-class from best-effort providers
retry, timeout, and prompt-caching semantics must be equivalently available across Anthropic and Bedrock paths within each provider's native transport
REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL, REBAR_LLM_API_KEY, and REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER must compose to route requests through an OpenAI-compatible provider to a custom endpoint
